```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(here)
```

```{r}
# Zenodo record details
record_id <- "22679902"
zip_filename <- "code_input_data.zip"

# Destination directory
data_dir <- here::here("data")
dir.create(data_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Increase timeout for large downloads
old_timeout <- getOption("timeout")
options(timeout = 3600)

# Temporary files
zip_path <- tempfile(fileext = ".zip")
extract_dir <- tempfile()

dir.create(extract_dir)

# Ensure temporary files are removed, even if an error occurs
cleanup_temp_files <- function() {
  unlink(zip_path)
  unlink(extract_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

tryCatch({

  # Construct direct Zenodo download URL
  download_url <- paste0(
    "https://zenodo.org/records/",
    record_id,
    "/files/",
    utils::URLencode(zip_filename, reserved = TRUE),
    "?download=1"
  )

  # Download ZIP
  message("Downloading data to /data. This can take several minutes.")
  download.file(
    url = download_url,
    destfile = zip_path,
    method = "libcurl",
    mode = "wb"
  )

  # Check that the archive is readable
  archive_contents <- unzip(zip_path, list = TRUE)

  if (nrow(archive_contents) == 0) {
    stop("The ZIP archive appears to be empty.")
  }

  # Extract files
  unzip(
    zipfile = zip_path,
    exdir = extract_dir
  )

  # Identify extracted contents
  extracted_items <- list.files(
    extract_dir,
    full.names = TRUE,
    all.files = TRUE,
    no.. = TRUE
  )

  # If the archive contains a single top-level directory, copy its
  # *contents* into data_dir rather than the directory itself, to avoid
  # creating a nested data/data directory.
  if (length(extracted_items) == 1 && dir.exists(extracted_items)) {
    extracted_items <- list.files(
      extracted_items,
      full.names = TRUE,
      all.files = TRUE,
      no.. = TRUE
    )
  }

  # Copy into data directory
  if (length(extracted_items) > 0) {

    copied <- file.copy(
      from = extracted_items,
      to = data_dir,
      recursive = TRUE,
      overwrite = TRUE
    )

    if (!all(copied)) {
      stop("Some extracted files could not be copied.")
    }

  } else {
    stop("No files were extracted from the ZIP archive.")
  }

  message("Data downloaded and extracted successfully.")

}, finally = {

  # Clean up temporary files
  cleanup_temp_files()

  # Restore original timeout
  options(timeout = old_timeout)

})

message("Data downloaded and extracted successfully.")
```

sessionInfo()
